newsitem.title: USA: Payless Cashways Nov same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Payless Cashways Nov same store sales up.

text.p: Payless Cashways Inc said Thursday same store sales for November rose 1.4 percent. Total sales for the month, however, dropped 1.6 percent.
The November sales were presented on a four-week basis, adjusted for the Thanksgiving holiday.
Total sales for the year on a 52-week basis dropped three percent and comparable sales fell 2.5 percent.

For financial reporting purposes, November 1996 was a five-week sales period ended November 30, compared with a four-week sales period in November 1995. Fiscal 1996 had 53 weeks compared with 52 in 1995, Payless Cashways said.
On that basis, total sales for November increased 21 percent to $233.2 million from $192.7 million, and same store sales rose 25.1 percent.
Year-to-date sales fell 1.4 percent to $2.64 billion from $2.68 billion, while same store sales were down 0.8 percent.
